risk_if_not_implemented: Without Harvest Now, Decrypt Later (HNDL) Mitigation, sensitive data with long confidentiality lifetimes remains protected only by quantum-vulnerable cryptography, exposing it to future decryption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), Long-Term Confidentiality Loss from Cryptographic Obsolescence (R-IP-1), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL) (MT-28), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Encrypting Data In Transit
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data in transit.
compensating_control_1.justification: Encrypting Data In Transit (CRY-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Harvest Now, Decrypt Later (HNDL) Mitigation (QTS-05) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Boundary Protection
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor and control communications at the external network boundary and at key internal boundaries within the network.
compensating_control_2.justification: Boundary Protection (NET-03) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Harvest Now, Decrypt Later (HNDL) Mitigation (QTS-05) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
